name: FormFutura B.V.
summary: Dutch filament supplier founded in 2012 by Arnold Medenblik, operating largely as a B2B/wholesale brand serving 400+ resellers in 75+ countries. Carries the broadest material catalog among the European premium brands surveyed, from budget EasyFil consumer spools through high-temperature engineering polymers (PEEK, PEI, PEKK, PPSU, PPS), plus resins and pellets.

product_lines.name: EasyFil ePLA
product_lines.notes: The 'e' is marketing positioning (economical/European/eco-packaged), not a chemistry marker; TDS shows plain PLA at 1.24 g/cc

product_lines.name: Tough PLA
product_lines.notes: Impact-modified PLA marketed for higher impact resistance

product_lines.name: Premium PLA Flame Retardant
product_lines.notes: PLA + flame-retardant package; abs-fr has no PLA equivalent

product_lines.name: Volcano PLA / Volcano PLA 150C
product_lines.notes: High-crystallinity PLA (density 1.27 g/cc) formulated for post-print annealing - HDT rises to ~95 C annealed vs ~55-60 C unannealed; base polymer is still PLA per TDS, no annealable-PLA grade id exists

product_lines.name: Transparent PLA
product_lines.notes: Optical variant on the same base polymer

product_lines.name: High Gloss PLA / High Gloss PLA ColorMorph
product_lines.notes: Cosmetic gloss and colour-shift variants; not confirmed to be a silk-additive or gradient formulation, so pla-silk/pla-gradient are not assigned

product_lines.name: Galaxy PLA
product_lines.notes: Sparkle/glitter-effect PLA; no glitter-filled PLA id exists

product_lines.name: EasyFil PLA Glow in the Dark
ReForm rPLA / ReFill PLA
product_lines.notes: Recycled PLA, also sold as pellets

product_lines.name: StoneFil
product_lines.notes: PLA matrix + stone/mineral filler; no stone-filled PLA id exists

product_lines.name: ApolloX
product_lines.notes: Engineering-tuned ASA - higher impact strength and lower warp than commodity ASA; modifier undisclosed

product_lines.name: Centaur (PP)
product_lines.notes: Polypropylene including a medical-grade pellet variant

product_lines.name: PCL
product_lines.notes: Polycaprolactone, a low-melting biodegradable polyester for hand-mouldable/low-temp use; no pcl id exists

product_lines.name: TPU
product_lines.notes: Standard thermoplastic polyurethane; grade hardnesses not enumerated this pass

product_lines.name: TPC
product_lines.notes: Thermoplastic copolyester elastomer (TPE-E); the cope entry is a rigid high-speed copolyester, not an elastomer, so no TPC id exists

product_lines.name: Composite and specialty grades
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre, glass-fibre, metal-fill, wood-fill and stone-fill grades plus flame-retardant, food-safe and chemical/UV/water-resistant specialties layered onto the base chemistries; individual CF/GF matrix subtypes beyond Premium PLA CF03 were not enumerated this pass

additional_notes: Price tier spans a wide range that a single enum cannot capture: EasyFil is budget-to-mid while ApolloX and the PEEK/PEI/PEKK range is engineering-tier; 'mid' is the catalog midpoint. No confirmed evidence that FormFutura white-labels for other retail brands or resells another OEM, so no oem_relationships are recorded; it does not appear in research/verified-oem-relationships.md. Explicitly distinct from Dutch Filaments B.V. (acquired by Mitsubishi Chemical in 2018), an unrelated Dutch filament company - flagged because the two are easily confused. Partners with Brazil-based Thibra3D on specific formulations; that is a collaboration, not ownership or an OEM supply arrangement. Sells FEP film, adhesives, spool holders and resin-cleaning accessories but no build plate was found, so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: HQ city is unresolved: Facebook lists Nijmegen, other sources say Amsterdam (likely Nijmegen operations with Amsterdam registration). Manufacturing origin is claimed as Netherlands but in-house extrusion versus contract manufacturing was not confirmed, so manufacturing_countries should be treated as provisional. price_tier compresses a budget-through-engineering range into one value.
